title: Hairline Tattoo Business Tracker | Spreadsheet Template (Excel/Google Sheets)
description_html:
Manage your Scalp Micropigmentation (SMP) business with ease using this Hairline Tattoo Studio Tracker! Whether you are a newly certified artist or a seasoned professional, this editable spreadsheet template for Excel and Google Sheets is designed to keep your appointments, client progress, and finances flawlessly organized.

Easily track client details, log individual hairline tattoo sessions (including pigment shades and healing notes), and monitor your supply inventory so you never run out of essential inks or needles. Features automated totals to calculate your quoted revenue and individual session fees.

  • Works seamlessly in Excel & Google Sheets
  • Fully editable and customizable
  • Instant digital download
  • Perfect for SMP and permanent makeup artists

Please note: This is a digital file. No physical item will be shipped. For personal and business use only; not for resale.
